item.title: The Anthropic IPO, Grid Bottlenecks, and the AI Spending Wars
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:

item.title: Industrial Intelligence: The Next Growth Frontier in Manufacturing
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Discover how manufacturers are leveraging Physical AI and industrial intelligence to turn accumulated know-how into a compounding engine for profitable growth.
[SPLIT] ⚡ Physical AI enables machines to perceive conditions, reason about variables, and execute validated physical actions.
